## Scope / 范围

Describe the focused change and link related issues.

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Native build and CTest when `plugin/`, CMake, or packaging changed
- [ ] Visual/performance evidence attached when rendering changed
- [ ] New dependencies and fixtures have compatible licenses and notices
- [ ] No credentials, private scenes, tokens, or full private paths are included
